name: Cosmetics and personal-care manufacturing
signals: mustahdarat tajmeel ’itr ( influencer launch, Daraz/Noon/Amazon listing
shape_facts: Own brand, private-label for others, or both.
Product types (skincare, haircare, soaps, fragrances/oud/bakhoor, colour cosmetics, henna).
Number of SKUs and launches per year.
Sales channels: own website, Instagram/TikTok, marketplaces (Daraz, Noon, Amazon), pharmacies/retail chains, salons, exports.
In-house filling and packing or outsourced.
Imported raw materials and packaging (jars, pumps, bottles) share.
Team size for production, marketing and customer service.
scope_rule: pi notes business problems: batches, packaging stock, launches, marketplace operations, returns, influencer costs, retailer credit, quality complaints and reporting. It never gives formulation, ingredient-safety, skin/medical, claims-compliance, labelling-law or product-registration advice, and does not judge whether a product is safe. It records no customer personal data, skin conditions or photos of people, and no influencer personal details — only roles. If a customer reaction sounds serious (swelling, breathing difficulty, eye injury), pi says urgent medical help is needed and points to emergency services.

problems.phrase: Customer says the cream gave her a rash and posted it on Instagram
Same product feels different batch to batch
Packaging supplier MOQ forces us to buy 10,000 jars we can’t use
Pumps and droppers arrive defective and leak
Launch delayed because the boxes weren’t printed on time
We spend on influencers and have no idea which ones sell
Meta ads cost more every month for the same sales
COD orders get refused at the door, RTO is killing us
Courier COD money comes late and never matches our list
Orders from Instagram DMs, WhatsApp, website and Daraz — some slip through
Fake versions of our product are sold on marketplaces
Old packaging stock is dead after a rebrand
Products near expiry are with retailers and they want to return them
Private label clients change artwork after we’ve ordered packaging
We don’t know true cost per unit including packaging, ads and returns
Pharmacy chains pay in 60–90 days
Customers don’t reorder after the first purchase
DMs and comments go unanswered for a day
Free PR products and samples leave the store without records
Bad reviews on Noon/Daraz about leakage in transit
Registration and import documents for each new product take ages
Raw material count never matches what’s on paper
Website checkout breaks on mobile
We can’t see which channel actually makes money

complaints: What kind of complaints come in most — quality, leakage, reactions or delivery?
batches: Do customers notice differences between batches?
Can you tell which batch a complaint relates to?
packaging: Which packaging item causes the most trouble?
How much unused packaging is sitting in stock?
marketing: Which channels do you spend on?
How do you know which influencer or ad brought sales?
orders and cod: Roughly what share of orders are COD?
How often do they come back?
channels: How are they collected into one place?
retail/pharmacy: How do they pay and return stock?
margins: How do you work out cost per unit?

seasons: PK wedding season (October–March) for bridal skincare, henna and gift sets; Eid ul Fitr (Chand Raat henna, gift boxes) and Eid ul Adha; winter moisturisers and summer sunscreen/deodorant; 11.11 and Black Friday sales on Daraz. UAE: Ramadan and Eid gifting (oud, bakhoor, perfume sets), Dubai Shopping Festival (December–January), White Friday on Noon/Amazon, Mother’s Day (21 March), summer travel lull. Canada: holiday gift sets (November–December), Black Friday/Cyber Monday, Valentine’s and Mother’s Day.
care: No formulation, ingredient safety, dermatological or medical advice; note complaints as business problems only.
Serious reactions (swelling, breathing problems, eye injury): pi urges urgent medical help and emergency services; no details of the person are recorded.
No advice on labelling claims, whitening/mercury rules, halal certification or registration; note admin effort only.
Never help copy another brand’s packaging, fake halal or certification marks, or relabel expired stock — decline.
No customer photos, skin conditions or contact details stored; roles and counts only.
Influencer contracts and disclosure rules: no legal advice.
Fake reviews: pi does not help write or buy them.
build_ideas: Batch register: batch number, fill date, expiry, raw-material lots, and channels shipped to.
Packaging component stock board with MOQ, open POs and usage per SKU.
Launch tracker: formulation sign-off, packaging, printing, photography, listing and stock-ready dates.
Unified order inbox pulling website, Daraz/Noon/Amazon and WhatsApp orders into one list.
COD reconciliation: courier remittance files matched to orders, with gaps flagged.
RTO tracker by city, courier and channel, with WhatsApp confirmation before dispatch.
Influencer and ad tracker with unique codes or links per influencer and orders attributed.
Complaint log linked to SKU and batch, with response time tracking.
Unit economics sheet: product cost, packaging, shipping, ads and return rate per SKU.
Repeat-purchase reminders on WhatsApp for customers who opted in.
Retailer/pharmacy ledger with stock, near-expiry and receivables.
Owner dashboard: sales by channel, ad spend vs orders, RTO rate, top SKUs, stock cover.

exchange.text: We send products to so many influencers but I honestly can’t tell if any of it is working.
That’s a really common frustration, and an expensive one. Noted — influencer spend with no clear link to sales. Roughly how many influencers do you work with in a month?
Around 15 to 20, mostly PR boxes, a few paid.
Noted, 15–20 a month, mostly PR boxes. When a sale comes in, is there any way right now to see where the customer came from?
